cohort_plan.selection_rule: Within each predeclared complexity stratum, retain the original primary order, replace a baseline-ineligible primary with the first baseline-eligible reserve in the listed order, and keep exactly eight bugs per stratum. Eligibility is decided before any model generation.
cohort_plan.source_sample: Deterministic component-diverse sample from scripts/select_experiment_sample.py; primary set is the medium and hard strata, with reserves in the same strata.

reserve_sampling.rule: Use the deterministic medium/hard tier order after the eight primaries; 78621 is promoted into the medium primary slot vacated by 91369.

excluded_before_model.reason: The unpatched Alive2 run returned one failed-to-prove case and ERROR: Timeout, with zero incorrect transformations. No model request was made; this is verifier-unresolved, not a repair failure.

primary_comparisons.question: Does IR-aware witness reduction improve repair over unreduced feedback with the same structured renderer?
Does paired witness-aware reduction improve repair over sequential llvm-reduce with the same renderer?
Does structured rendering improve repair when neither witness is reduced?

rationale: The v3b main sweep halted before any model request for 91369 because Alive2 timed out before establishing a clean semantic violation. This amendment keeps the four feedback arms, model, prompt, trials, validation and inference plan fixed; it replaces only that verifier-unresolved medium-tier bug using the deterministic reserve order. A no-model eligibility preflight validates the selected cohort before generation. The resolved cohort is the first 8 clean-baseline candidates in each predeclared stratum.
inference: Exact paired one-sided McNemar in the three stated directions, Benjamini-Hochberg across all three. Unit is one bug with pass@3. Report paired effect sizes and all counts. No optional stopping or selected extra trials.
notes: This sample is the two remaining preselected size tiers, not a pristine unseen set: 115149 had previous diagnostic exposure.
Bug 91369 is excluded as verifier-unresolved before model exposure; it must never be counted as a repair failure.
Do not pool v2, local FP8 offload, a smaller model or a hosted API as one experiment.
The shared text renderer is fixed, but its derived fields depend on the displayed IR; this is a comparison of complete feedback pipelines.
There are no generic-ddmin, no-counterexample or promotion ablation repair-rate claims under this four-arm schedule. Reducer-only development ablations are separate.
Do not guarantee significance or journal acceptance from a 16-bug follow-up.
Credit eligibility, remaining balance and account rate limits must be confirmed before generation.
Reservation ledger counts every explicitly attempted generation at configured prompt/output ceilings; it is not a bill or credit balance. Prices/taxes/provider overhead may differ.
A context or budget guard stops the sweep and preserves partial records; it is not reported as a completed negative repair result.
Do not change model or thinking policy after observing main-sample outcomes. API pilot and full validation are required.
The legacy benchmark cutoff date is not a verified training cutoff. No contamination-free or SLM-size claim is supported for Gemini.
The seven-token operator smoke response is account-access evidence only, not a repair result or proof of credit application.
Preserve all Vertex retry reservations. Check credit eligibility/balance before main evaluation; no zero-bill guarantee.
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is not interchangeable with Gemini 2.5 Flash; prior Developer API plans are preserved as history.
Prompt refresh and LOW thinking were introduced together in v3b; no isolated effect of either is estimated.
No reference patch, target-specific bounds hint or failed-test expectation is injected into the prompt. Ordinary recorded diagnostics remain available to all arms.
The original failed pilot and its ledger are retained; the v3b pilot ledger is separate from earlier pilot ledgers and the main ledger.

Do not pool the original MINIMAL pilot or any old-source main records with these outcomes. The v3c amendment preserves only completed, treatment-identical v3b cells for bugs retained in the final cohort, with original provenance attached.

Preflight validates unpatched build, reproducer and a clean Alive2 semantic violation; it makes no model requests. If the candidate pool cannot produce eight eligible bugs in either stratum, do not start the sweep.
